title: What he left out
note: Al-Bukhari's sieve, and the idea underneath it: weigh the chain of names before you weigh the text.

beats.text: Al-Bukhari kept only what he could prove
Born in Bukhara in the year 810

beats.callsub: from Iraq, Syria, Egypt and Arabia
where did you live, who did you meet

beats.text: Then almost all of it goes

beats.callsub: out of everything he had gathered
and he wrote down why, by name

beats.text: Check the people, then the words
beats.sub: who said it, before what was said

beats.text: One of the first tests of evidence
